name: @smakss/random-array-element
description: Efficiently select unique, non-repeating random elements from arrays with @smakss/random-array-element. Ideal for varied applications needing random but exhaustive array item selection.
author: SMAKSS

scripts.build:playground: pnpm run generate && pnpm --filter random-array-element-playground build
scripts.dev:playground: pnpm run generate && pnpm --filter random-array-element-playground dev
scripts.generate:check: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:main && pnpm run lint:playground
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm exec husky install
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b . && pnpm run generate:types && tsc -p tsconfig.package-types.json && pnpm --filter random-array-element-playground typecheck
scripts.typecheck:playground: pnpm run generate:types && pnpm --filter random-array-element-playground typecheck
